messages:
maria: FYI the Go sample app in quickstarts still uses REDWOOD_API_KEY and calls https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/legacy. New onboarding fails with 401s.

maria: snippet from README:
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp, err := client.Generate("Hello")
```
That env var doesn't exist in new onboarding flow.

aj: Oof. We renamed to REDWOOD_API_TOKEN and switched to NewClientWithOpts(ctx, Option{Token:...}) last quarter. Did the sample get forked? :facepalm:

maria: Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quickstarts/go-sample, file README.md line ~42

chris: I can PR. Fixes:
- change env var to REDWOOD_API_TOKEN
- update snippet to use redwood.New(ctx, redwood.WithToken(token))
- handle 429 Retry-After header in example (show basic backoff)
Example:
```go
token := os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_TOKEN")
c := redwood.New(ctx, redwood.WithToken(token))
for {
  resp, err := c.Generate(ctx, opts)
  if err != nil {
    if apiErr, ok := err.(redwood.APIError); ok && apiErr.StatusCode == 429 {
      wait := apiErr.RetryAfter
      time.Sleep(wait)
      continue
    }
    log.Fatal(err)
  }
  fmt.Println(resp.Text)
  break
}
```

sophie: Also the Dockerfile still does `go get github.com/redwood-inference/old-sdk@v0.3.0` which pulls outdated deps and breaks `go mod tidy` in Go 1.21. Need to replace with `github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go` and add Go version note.

lucy: I'll open the PR and include a note in the changelog about snippet parity and add a tiny integration test that runs the example with a fake token.

doc-bot: created PR #2103 by lucy to update go-sample README, Dockerfile, and add test.

aj: If you need help with APIError type or RetryAfter shape ping me, I can add a small helper in the SDK to read Retry-After as time.Duration.

maria: Thanks! That should unblock the onboarding smoke tests. :thumbsup:
